comment: Grafana panel definitions for the billing Prometheus metrics. Import via Grafana → Dashboards → New → Import → paste this JSON, then attach each panel to your operator dashboard. The panels assume the standard ``prometheus`` datasource; replace the datasource uid in your environment if it differs.

panels.title: Stripe webhook events (per minute)
panels.description: Volume of inbound webhook events broken down by Stripe event_type and our dispatch outcome. A healthy line shows a tight cluster of 'processed' with occasional 'duplicate' (Stripe retries); spikes in 'error' or 'invalid_signature' are red flags.

panels.title: Webhook errors — alert eligible
panels.description: Rolling 5-minute count of webhook handler errors. Anything > 0 should page the on-call: a real Stripe event blew up during dispatch and our DB state may now disagree with Stripe's.

panels.title: Invalid webhook signatures
panels.description: Rolling 5-minute count of signature-verification failures. > 1 means either STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET drift between Stripe Dashboard and .env, OR someone hitting /billing/webhook directly without the secret.

panels.title: Extras quantity sync outcomes
panels.description: Per-minute rate of sync_billing_quantity calls grouped by result. Most ticks should be 'noop' (active-vehicle count unchanged). 'patched' is healthy — Stripe was updated. 'stripe_error' is the alarm: Stripe API failed and the customer's next invoice will be wrong.

panels.title: Stripe sync errors (sustained)
panels.description: 15-minute count of sync_billing_quantity Stripe API failures. Sustained > 0 across multiple intervals means the activity → Stripe path is broken; the billing-period close will reflect a stale qty.

panels.title: Billing notifications dispatched
panels.description: Telegram-recipient reach per notification kind (checkout_complete, payment_failed, payment_recovered, comp_*). The value is the cumulative count of Owner/Admin admins reached — zero increments on a known-billed event mean either no admins exist for that account or the per-account bot isn't registered.

panels.title: Comp lifecycle — daily sweep
panels.description: Daily ticks from run_comp_expiry_sweep. 'checked' = active accounts scanned; 'expired' = comps flipped off on this run; 'reminder_sent' = expiring-soon Telegram pings (7/3/1-day buckets). 'expired' counts the accounts that just lost comp coverage — confirm finance + support are aware.

alert_recommendations.name: billing-webhook-error-rate
alert_recommendations.summary: Stripe webhook handler crashed on a real event

alert_recommendations.name: billing-invalid-signature-burst
alert_recommendations.summary: Multiple webhook signature failures — secret drift or probing

alert_recommendations.name: billing-sync-stripe-error-sustained
alert_recommendations.summary: Active-vehicle qty no longer syncing to Stripe — next invoice will be wrong
